$$
x + (x + 1.00) = 1.10
$$  
Simplifying:  
$$
2x + 1.00 = 1.10
$$  
Subtracting $1.00 from both sides:  
$$
2x = 0.10
$$  
Dividing by 2:  
$$
x = 0.05
$$
